name: Demersal & inshore fish
description: Bottom-living and inshore fishes: mullet (Liza richardsonii), pelagic-feeding demersals (anglerfish, Cape john dory, ribbonfish), benthic-feeding demersals (kingklip, monkfish, gurnards, rattails) and Agulhas sole (Austroglossus pectoralis). Functional group pooling these four source compartments - the guild of fishes that live on or near the seafloor; pooled to fit the 25-node ceiling.
